content:
Connor O'Brien: sanity check on release notes wording for the provision-to-ready rollout + do we need a formal change-management entry for this? this is the one that adds readiness gate before nodes join serving pools + dashboards/alerts.

Talia Benson: +1, need to finalize for tomorrow’s internal release train notes. also want to be clear if this is “infra-only” vs “platform behavior change.”

Vanessa Ortiz: it’s a behavior change in fleet bring-up: nodes won’t be added to serving pools until validations pass (gpu health, driver parity, nccl smoke, perf canary). feature-flagged by region/pool type.

Harish Reddy: from ops perspective: this will prevent half-baked nodes from entering Dedicated pools (good), but in the short term could reduce “available” capacity if validations are too strict or flaky. so it’s not purely cosmetic.

Connor O'Brien: agreed. my draft release note:
“Dedicated fleet provisioning now uses automated provision-to-ready gating (health + driver parity + networking + NCCL + perf canary) before nodes are admitted to serving pools. Rollout is staged (us-east / A100 first) behind feature flag; includes new dashboards + failure reason surfacing + quarantine on repeated failures.”

Aisha Bello: wording is fine, but I’d avoid listing every single validation in release notes. internal consumers mostly care about impact + where to look if stuck in Validating.

Sean Gallagher: +1, keep it actionable:
- what changed
- expected impact
- rollback / kill switch
- owner + oncall link
and yes, this should get a change-management entry. gating + quarantine can alter capacity + paging.

Priya Natarajan: for platform change log: it changes control-plane admission rules (readiness gate) even if only for new nodes. I’d treat as “medium risk” change w/ rollback toggle.

Connor O'Brien: ok, so: formal CM entry required. is this a “standard change” template or “normal change”?

Sean Gallagher: i’d do standard if we have a pre-approved template for staged infra rollouts; otherwise normal. but either way we need the record + rollback documented + comms to oncall.

Talia Benson: we have a standard change template for “feature-flagged infra rollouts w/ immediate rollback.” we can reuse that. Connor can you file it + link in release notes?

Sahana Iyer: +1 on CM. also please mention image channel is unchanged by default; only admission gating + telemetry. don’t want ppl to assume we’re pushing a new golden image this train.

Vanessa Ortiz: +1. image pipeline work is separate; for this train we’re enabling readiness service + validation agent + admission gate. images stay pinned.

Connor O'Brien: revised release note proposal (shorter):
“Provision-to-ready gating is now available for Dedicated fleet expansions: new GPU nodes must pass automated validation before joining serving pools. Rollout is staged (us-east/A100 first) behind a region+pool feature flag. Operators can view readiness state + failure reasons in the Fleet Readiness dashboard; repeated validation failures auto-quarantine nodes. Rollback: disable feature flag to revert to pre-gating admission.”

Aisha Bello: looks good. add link to dashboard + runbook if possible.

Harish Reddy: +1 and maybe a single sentence on expected behavior: “nodes may stay in Validating longer but fewer post-provision break/fix.”

Fiona McCarthy: CM entry should also note audit/eventing: image channel changes are audited; readiness state mutations are logged. no new external access, but still worth noting for compliance.

Ethan Park: +1. also clarify who can mutate readiness state (service only) vs read-only for tooling. avoids confusion.

Connor O'Brien: cool. final tweak:
“Note: readiness states are written by the readiness service; humans/tools have read-only access except break-glass.”

Talia Benson: :thumbsup: ship it. Connor please:
1) file CM entry w/ risk=medium, staged rollout, kill switch, rollback triggers
2) update internal release notes w/ links: dashboard + triage runbook

Connor O'Brien: will do. CM entry going in as Standard Change “Fleet provisioning gating (us-east/A100)” w/ owners Vanessa/Harish, SRE pager Sean/Rafael. will paste link here once filed.

Sean Gallagher: thanks. please include alerting note in CM: initial alerts are ticket-only for 48h; paging only if time-to-ready P95 > threshold OR failure rate spikes.

Connor O'Brien: ack, adding that. :white_check_mark:
